Consumer behaviour in digital markets

For my MSc, I examined how people in Wales discovered a wedding décor business and what mattered when selecting a supplier. Building on this applied research, my prospective interests span digital consumer behaviour, AI in marketing, online trust, social commerce and digital customer experience.

Completed MSc research

Imani Events marketing plan

Cardiff Metropolitan University · January 2023

The question

Imani Events wanted to attract more customers. For my 17,500-word MSc project, I looked at how people first heard about the company and what they valued when choosing a wedding décor supplier.

How I approached it

I designed a questionnaire in Qualtrics and collected 56 responses from Cardiff and elsewhere in Wales. I examined the answers alongside competitors’ websites, search terms and the company’s routes for customer enquiries.

Primary research

Explore the survey findings

What I recommended

Word of mouth was how most respondents first heard about Imani, yet reviews and replies mattered when they chose a supplier. I recommended showing past work on a mobile-friendly website, making enquiries easy and sharing event photographs alongside customer comments on social media.

The survey describes the preferences of the people who took part. A follow-up study could examine whether changing the website affects enquiries or bookings.

Prospective doctoral interests

Questions I would like to pursue

Digital consumer behaviour

How do consumers search, compare alternatives and make decisions across online channels?

AI in marketing

How might AI-supported recommendations and personalisation affect consumer engagement?

Consumer trust and transparency

When do reviews, recommendations and disclosures help people assess the credibility of digital information?

Social commerce

How do social platforms and interpersonal recommendations shape product discovery and purchase intentions?

Digital customer experience

How could interactive features and service design influence customers’ confidence and experience?
